notes.title: Expert mode, betting, elite monsters, run cancel & more!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/DDare_Update_Hard.PNG[/img]

To thanks to our fans and players for the support, here's another big update for Devil's Dare! In this update, we've made several balancing tweaks to the game based on our players feedback since release, as well as new ideas to spice up the gameplay.

[h1]Expert mode & Betting[/h1]
The expert mode isn't just a simple tweak to the monster health and damage. Instead, players can choose to bet on their game. If you feel confident enough, challenge yourself by increasing the revive cost and take on some elite monsters. Killing them won't only be harder, but also more rewarding. Find out if you've got what it takes!

On top of that, health will no longer recovers at the end of each night in expert mode. Players will have to decide if they were to purchase an upgrade, or spend a little to recover their health instead.

[h1]Dodge & Run[/h1]
Instead of a running away, players now dodge before they run off. Giving them a split second invincibility to get out of danger.

[h1]Run Cancel[/h1]
When performing a combo, special moves or picking up items, press run to cancel your previous action immediately. This allows players to run away from danger or perform more combos at the expense of 1 Soul Point.

[h1]Special Cancel[/h1]
More of a reminder than a new feature, the game actually feature special cancel. For example, when performing a Shield Dash, player can cancel the attack halfway to perform a Sword Spin, allowing him to deal more damage.

[h1]Game Balancing & Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Boss Fight Timer : Players can no longer grind in boss fight. Each boss fight must be completed in time, else player will die when the time is up!
    [*]Game Freezing Effects : Previously, when players uses a special moves, the game freezes and darken entirely. As good as it looks, it was rather disruptive for multiplayer mode. It's now a lot shorter and smooth, and only appears on Breakout and Special Cancel.
    [*]Kingston Piledriver : Now cost only 2 Soul Points, though damage is reduced.
    [*]Monster Armor : Stronger monsters like Mama's Boy and Mister X now freeze a little longer when hit, giving players a split second longer to escape when the monsters fight back.
    [*]Skip Convention : Players can now skip the convention entirely from the character selection screen if they've gameover from the game once.
[/list]

That is all for now and I hope old and new players can find joy in the game. Happy holiday, everyone!

notes.title: WIN $USD666 & Appear in the game!
notes.content:
[img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/HiscoreChallenge.gif[/img]

Play Devil's Dare and stand a chance to win attractive prizes!

Devil's Dare is a beat'em up that features a unique arcade style, permadeath mechanics. The only way to revive is by spending hard earned money made by killing zombies. Yet this money is also used for upgrades and taken as your score when the game ends.

Here's the catch.

With the Devil's Dare high score challenge, we're offering attractive prizes to our top players! That is USD$166.50 for each of the top ranking players on our 4 leaderboards(base on the number of players), adding up to a total of $666!

If you consider yourself the very best, this is your chance to prove it, get rich and be immortalize forever  in Devil's Dare.

This opportunity is not limited to the single player mode, as the game features 4 leaderboards, each based on the number of players in the game. So gather your friends and get ready for a night of awesomeness!


[h1][b]INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Own a steam account.
    [*]Purchase the game on Steam!
    [*]Play the arcade mode with classic difficulty. 
    [*]Your remaining cash is your final score when the game ends.
    [*]Your score is automatically submited at the game over screen 
    [*]Make sure you are online, so your score can be submitted to Steam's leaderboard.
    [*]Hold on to your position, because any one can beat you to it before the deadline!
    [*]Challenge ends on 9th Novemeber 2014, 23:59:59 Pacific Time.
[/olist]


[h1][b]REWARDS[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*][b]First Place : USD$166.50 & Appear as a statue in the final level[/b]
    [*]Second Place : Appears as living character
    [*]Third Place : Appears as a corpse in the game
    [*]Forth to Tenth Place : An additional copy of Devil's Dare
[/olist]

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTES[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Challenge is restricted only for the Classic difficulty mode leaderboards.
    [*]Rewards applies to all 4 leaderboards based on the number of players. This includes the single player mode, 2 players mode, 3 players mode and 4 players mode.
    [*]Across all 4 boards, that adds up to a total of USD$666 to be won. However, rewards are given to the Steam account owners only. This means that for the multiplayer mode, only the Steam account holder will make an appearence in our game.
    [*]The same steam account owner can win multiple times.
    [*]Cash rewards will be handed out strictly via Paypal only.
    [*]We will try our best to contact the winner, but we will need the winners to try to reach out to us too.
    [*]We will need the player to validate that you are the Steam account holder.
    [*]Rewards will be handed out before 30th November 2014.
    [*]Rewards will be forfeited if you are unable to varify yourself.
    [*]Rewards will be forfeited if left unclaim by 30th November 2014.
    [*]All rules & regulation are subjected to change as we deem necessary!
[/olist]


[h1][b]EVEN MORE IMPORTANT NOTES![/b][/h1]
This is the first time we're organising a challange of this size, so if you intend to take part, take note that things might take a while and we might make mistake. If that happens, we apologize in advance.

I also like to point out that we are starting this challenge in trust and good faith in the gaming community. So I hope that we will not see any cheats, hacks or death threat. This is a game. We are here to have fun. So let's do that.

Unfortunately, due to the compeition, we will be erasing the current leaderboard and starting anew before we upload the latest patch on 31st October 2014.

Finally, note that this challenge is solely a private transaction between Secret Base and the respective winners. Valve and Steam were not involve, other than us, using the Steam leaderboard. If you have any questions, feel free to drop it below!

[quote][b]CHALLENGE BEGINS ON 30th Oct 2014 23:59 Pacfic Time![/b]
Please spread the news and tell your friends about it!

Unfortunately, due to the contest and out latest patch, we will be erasing the current leaderboard. Some saved game might also be affected. We apologize in advance. The new Update includes the Survival mode, Casual Difficulty & a free demo. Click on the image below to find out more.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/devilsdare/announcements/detail/246897116081057731][img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/DemoxCasualXSurvival.PNG[/img]
[/url][/quote]
NEW RULE (1 Nov) : This is all skill based, so anyone is free to try. This includes reviewers, let's player, etc. ANYONE, so long you don't cheat.

notes.title: Free Demo x Casual Difficulty x Survival Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/Tenkaichi.PNG[/img]

Coming this Halloween, we will be adding a few new features to the game, free of charge! There will be a little something for everyone, so hopefully if you've enjoyed the game so far, please help us to spread the word and share it with your friends!


[img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/DemoxCasualXSurvival.PNG[/img]


[h1][b]SURVIVAL MODE & LEADERBOARD[/b][/h1]
Firstly, for our early supporters who has already familiarised with the game, we have a new survival mode for 1-4 players. Just like the arcade mode, we have separate leaderboards based on the number of players in the game.

[h1][b] CASUAL DIFFICULTY [/b][/h1]
Next up, for the more casual gamers, fret not as we've added a casual difficulty to the game. It doesn't dumb things down completely and should still provide a moderate challenge. And by the end of it, it should gear you up with the skills and knowledge to take on our original, Classic mode.

[h1][b] FREE DEMO [/b][/h1]
Lastly, for players that are still hesitant about Devil's Dare, there's a free demo for you to try out! There's a single level available in the demo, but you are free to try out all the characters. So be sure to give it a shot!


[quote]IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT : As we're adding a new patch to encrypt the saved data, we are going to have to reset our current leaderboard and delete current saved data. We are very sorry about this, but this is also due to the new $666 contest we're hosting, and I apologize in advance and thank you for your understanding.[/quote]

[quote][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/devilsdare/announcements/detail/246897116138847979][img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/HiscoreChallenge.gif[/img][/url][/quote][/quote]

notes.title: Halloween Contest : Win a copy of Devil's Dare!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/279580/extras/Beat'em_Art.JPG?t=1414406290[/img]
After years of sweat, tears and pixels, Devil's Dare is finally here on Steam!

In celebration of the release and the Halloween season, we are hosting a Halloween contest! All you have to do is to either tweet us a photo of your Halloween costume, or your drawing of a zombified iconic game/movie character. Follow us and share it on twitter with #devilsdare!

Even if you already own a copy of the game, join in and have fun! Win an additional copy to trade it off with a friend!


TOTAL OF 10 COPIES TO BE WON! 
1. Awarded to top 5 most beautiful.
2. Awarded to top 5 most ridiculous.

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Take a photo of your Halloween costume or draw a zombified version of an iconic game/movie character.
2. Include the link www.devilsdare.com
3. Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/secretbaseSG
4. Tweet the photo/artwork with #devilsdare and include @secretbaseSG in the tweet.
5. Deadline : 31st October 2014 

NOTE 
1. Winners will be announced and awarded on 2nd November 2014.
2. Artworks will be judge by Secret Base.
3. While there are no age-restrictions, priority will be given to students.
4. Note that this is all done in good will and trust in the gamers community, so please do not send in artwork that does not belong to you.
5. May the odds be forever in your favor!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Here are the winners! - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

[img]http://bitejacker.secretbase.com.sg/DDareArt_Thumb.PNG[/img]

The prize has already been sent out to the respective winners via Twitter so please remember to check it. I'd appreciate if you guys could put it up on the community hub too to share it with the rest of the guys here :)
